## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and related task or issue.

## Validation

List commands/checks run, their results, and any checks still pending.

## Review and rollout

- [ ] An independent reviewer with write access has reviewed the latest changes.
- [ ] Required CI checks pass and review conversations are resolved.
- [ ] Architecture/API/data changes include the relevant decision and migration notes, where applicable.
- [ ] Rollback steps and material risks are documented, where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials or personal data are included in the change or its evidence.

Completing this checklist does not replace GitHub-enforced reviews or status checks.
